text:
Ava (Partnerships): Hey team — CloudCo confirmed booth 2A at MLCon (May 12-14). Want to sync on joint webinar + booth demo. Proposed shorthand agenda: 15m joint talk, 10m live demo, 5m Q&A, plus booth demos. Who can own what?
Marc (Events): I'll own logistics/AV. Need final slide deck + demo checklist by May 1. Booth staff slots: 3 people per day. 
Sasha (Prod Marketing): I'll handle PR and social — need embargo notes for any joint announcement. Also need speaker bios + headshots by Apr 28.
Jin (CloudCo): We can present joint cloud marketplace integration. Jin here — can demo provisioning via CloudCo Marketplace. Need a demo account + instructions to push a short-sim workload. @Raj can you provision?
Raj (Eng): Yep — I can spin up a short-lived Dedicated instance for the demo. Which model & dataset? Suggest using a small finetuned model to keep latency predictable. Also will provide a secure demo token; we've done ephemeral tokens before.
Emily (Solutions): For the live demo let's script a fallback: primary (hosted Redwood API) -> fallback (Dedicated) and show latency and cost from Console. Want to include a quick dashboard screenshot in slides.
Ava (Partnerships): Swag update — vendor quoted $2.6k for 500 stickers + 200 tees + 200 tote bags. Shipping to SF local meetup house by May 20 deadline. Need PO/approval.
Marc (Events): Budget approved up to $3k by Finance for co-marketing. I'll submit PO today. Shirt sizes: can we do 50 S, 80 M, 40 L, 20 XL, 10 XXL? 
Sasha (Prod Marketing): I'll draft the joint announcement copy. Jin — can CloudCo legal review copy by May 3? Also plan a co-branded landing page + tracking UTM.
Jin (CloudCo): Yes, legal will review. Jin to share brand assets and co-branding guide by Thu.
Raj (Eng): AV/run-of-show notes: the demo needs GPU pinning and KV cache enabled for warm start. I'll create a tiny runbook and share a snippet here:
```
# Demo runbook excerpt
1) Start dedicated-demo vm: ./deploy_demo.sh --region us-west1 --model redwood-lite-1
2) Load cache: /scripts/warm_kv.sh --size 200MB
3) Generate sample prompts: ./demo_prompts.json
4) If latency > 200ms, toggle batching_policy=low_latency
```
Emily (Solutions): Also add a slide showing Redwood Optimize recommendations — batching + quantization gains. I'll mock numbers.
Ava (Partnerships): Speakers: proposal — Ava intro, Jin partner segment, Raj demo engineer walkthrough, Sasha Q&A host. Agree?
Marc (Events): Works for me. Can we keep total live talk to 30m? AV constraints say 35 max including Qs.
Sasha (Prod Marketing): I'll prep the registration page copy and send to Growth for paid ads. Also want to run a small invite list to top 100 accounts.
Jin (CloudCo): We'll bring 2 reps onsite (Jin + Mira). Can we get 2 exhibitor badges per day from organizer?
Marc (Events): Organizer requested exhibitor names by May 5 — I'll collect and submit.
Ava (Partnerships): Next steps: Raj to share runbook + demo creds by Apr 24; Sasha to send PR draft Apr 29; Marc to submit PO today; Jin to share assets by Thu. Ping me once items done. :thumbsup:
OpsBot: Reminder — parking pass pickup window May 11-13. Link: https://mlcon.example/parking
Ava (Partnerships): Thanks all — let's re-run this thread if any blocker. I'll schedule a 30m sync for Apr 25 to finalize run-of-show.
